slug: 2025-09-03 Season 3 - Namibia's Digital Identity Journey - From Vision to Reality (UNDP)

NAM.note: The 2024 Act consolidates civil records by law, but no exchange with the ID system is stated.
Nothing on a number at birth.
The register was built by Namibia with support, but it is not stated to be in service or who maintains it.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: UNDP says Namibia built its own National Population Register, tested remote biometric enrolment on hand-held devices and is finalising preparations to launch the e-ID in 2026.
